definitions.explanation: A state of mental or emotional strain, especially before an important event.
A strained state of relations between groups or countries.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}で{緊張|きんちょう}した。
examples.english: I was nervous at the interview.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}の{緊張|きんちょう}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: Tension between the two countries is rising.

notes:
Functions as a noun and with する as a verb ({緊張|きんちょう}する = to be nervous/tense).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{緊張|きんちょう}する (to be nervous)
・{緊張|きんちょう}しないで (don't be nervous)
・{緊張|きんちょう}が{解|ほぐ}れる (tension eases)
・{緊張|きんちょう}が{高|たか}まる (tension rises)
・{緊張|きんちょう}{感|かん} (sense of tension)
